simplepasteimage-uploading: Progress label while clipboard images are uploaded.
simplepasteimage-progress: Progress while importing a rich clipboard fragment. $1 is the number of processed image occurrences (successful or failed), $2 is their total count.
simplepasteimage-upload-error: Upload failure notification. $1 is the number of failed images.
simplepasteimage-image-failed: Placeholder for an image that could not be uploaded.
